definitions.face_opening_mm: Mean signed normal distance between affine images of the same reference face; only opposing nonzero native digits for that cut are included. Null means no eligible pairs.
definitions.interior_volume_change_percent: 100 * (current signed tetrahedral volume / reference volume - 1); six tetrahedra per complete interior lattice cell, excluding cells crossing planned cut planes. Middle third for two-cut tofu, all sampled piece interiors otherwise. Inverted tets are counted, never hidden with abs().
definitions.centroid_x_from_start_mm: Equal-mass native particle centroids of fixed reference regions, ordered left to right; displacement from reference positions.
definitions.centroid_x_from_probe_mm: Same centroids relative to the exact saved motion-start frame; null before it. Continuous push: final-cut end (tofu 3.30 s, banana 5.30 s); legacy knife-push/no-push: 4.00 s; impulse: probe_time_s.
definitions.knife_on_material_x_n: Negative of recorded material reaction on the knife in world x at the preceding completed substep; negative means the knife pushes material left. Excludes drive and board.
definitions.knife_on_material_n: World xyz force of the knife on the material, N; negative of the saved material reaction on the knife at the preceding completed substep. Zero at the initial state. Excludes drive and board.
definitions.dynamic_viscosity_pa_s: Newtonian dynamic viscosity from the saved material configuration, Pa s; missing historical configuration fields mean the elastic value zero.
definitions.knife_material_force_n: Norm of recorded material reaction on the knife at the preceding completed substep; excludes guide, drive and board forces.
definitions.comparison_scope: Native DexLab measurements; original authors sampling and full configuration are unavailable, so these are not same-condition cross-method scores.
